globalNews.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
globalNews.summary: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

globalNews.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
globalNews.summary: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

globalNews.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
globalNews.summary: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

globalNews.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
globalNews.summary: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.

globalNews.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
globalNews.summary: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

cryptoNews.title: Liquid Network resumes block production after $320M exploit
cryptoNews.summary: Liquid restarted block production after deploying emergency software updates, though transactions and peg operations remain suspended as recovery efforts continue.

cryptoNews.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
cryptoNews.summary: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.

cryptoNews.title: EU finance groups push to remove tokenized securities cap
cryptoNews.summary: European finance and tokenization groups say Brussels should remove limits on assets admitted to DLT infrastructure or set a 1.5 trillion euro baseline if a cap remains.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin falls on US PPI overshoot as 30-year bond yield hits new 19-year high
cryptoNews.summary: Bitcoin fell with US stocks as high inflation and a further surge in oil prices coincided with another multidecade high for US bond yields.

cryptoNews.title: Coinbase, Moov to provide stablecoin infrastructure for US community banks
cryptoNews.summary: The partnership will provide stablecoin acceptance, settlement and real-time funding capabilities to over 1,000 community banks and credit unions.

aiNews.title: AI agents are flooding public services with new requests
aiNews.summary: “The vast majority of cases we find are people who are entitled to claim for something, claiming for that thing,” the researcher told TechCrunch.

aiNews.title: Maven Robotics wants to steal your robot deployment deal
aiNews.summary: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth today with a $100 million Series A and active deployments.

aiNews.title: AI research startup Listen Labs scrubbed a $1.5B funding round for Salesforce talks
aiNews.summary: Listen Labs walked away from a signed Series C term sheet from Menlo Ventures, sources say.

aiNews.title: OpenAI adds a prominent AI doomer to its board of directors
aiNews.summary: Paul Christiano, an influential AI researcher focused on alignment, is joining the OpenAI Foundation as a member of its board.

aiNews.title: Massachusetts hits data centers with new clean power rules
